headline: MIN @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 4.48 at ARI 4.60, with a projected total of 9.08. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIN: MIN moved -0.04 runs while ARI moved -0.31, changing the projected margin by +0.28 runs. The projected total fell -0.35, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -9.6%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Mike Paredes has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 4 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Bell, Byron Buxton, Gabriel Moreno, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
